tournaments.name: eFootball Mobile Ghana Championship
tournaments.description: The premier competitive online tournament for eFootball Mobile players in Ghana. Compete against the best mobile tacticians for esports glory, verified national rankings, and sponsor-supported rewards.
tournaments.rules: 1. All matches played on eFootball Mobile (Online Friend Match). 2. Standard 10-minute match duration with Extra Time and PKs enabled. 3. Standard authentic clubs only; no unauthorized game modifications. 4. Screenshots of final scoreline must be uploaded or verified via referee broadcast.
tournaments.sponsorInfo: Supported by Ghanaian Esports Community & Local Gaming Hubs. 1st Place: GH₵450 + Trophy; 2nd Place: GH₵250; 3rd Place: GH₵100.

templates.name: 16-Player Single Elimination Cup
templates.description: Standard 4-round bracket with 10-minute matches and extra time.
templates.rules: Standard 10-minute friend match with extra time & penalties.

announcements.title: Registration Officially Open for Season 1 — Accra Cup
announcements.content: The eFootball Mobile Ghana Championship Season 1 registrations are now open. Cross-play between Android and iOS is fully supported. Register your gamer tag to secure a seed in the 16-player single-elimination bracket.

auditLogs.details: Platform initialized for live tournament operations. All test fixtures cleared.
